description:
A patient record for 'Deleted Patient' (Identifier: BAH999999) was accidentally voided (soft-deleted) and needs to be recovered. 

Your goal is to find this voided record and restore it to active status.

Steps:
1. Log in to the OpenMRS Administration interface (https://localhost/openmrs/admin) using credentials: username 'superman', password 'Admin123'.
2. Navigate to 'Manage Patients'.
3. Search for 'Deleted Patient'. Note: You MUST enable the option to 'Include Voided' patients in your search, otherwise the record will not appear.
4. Open the patient record and use the 'Unvoid' or 'Restore' functionality to reactivate the patient.
5. Confirm the patient is no longer voided.
